Purpose: Species composition plots
- create average sample abundance bar chart
- create abundance and relative abundance heat maps

Necessary Environment Objects
- bugs: ISP main markdown

Environment Objects Created
- bugs_long
- bugs_long_prop

### Set Up
```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
```

### Data frame building

#### bugs_long
```{r}
bugs_long <- bugs %>%
  #filter(!(depth == "surber")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(stream, depth, station, season, year, tempDepth, doDepth, conductivityDepth, pHDepth, sample_id),
    names_to = "taxon",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(stream, depth, taxon) %>% #could go further and break down by year and season...
  summarise(total_count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

bugs_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = stream, y = total_count, fill = taxon)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ depth, ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Stream",
    y = "Total abundance",
    fill = "Taxon"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

#### bugs_long_prop
```{r}
bugs_long_prop <- bugs_long %>%
  group_by(stream, depth) %>%
  mutate(prop = total_count / sum(total_count)) %>%
  ungroup()

taxon_order <- bugs_long_prop %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(mean_prop) %>%
  pull(taxon)

bugs_long_prop <- bugs_long_prop %>%
  mutate(
    taxon = factor(taxon, levels = taxon_order),
    stream = factor(
      stream,
      levels = c("is-11", "is-10", "is-7", "is-1", "is-5", "is-6", "is-8")
    )
  )

ggplot(bugs_long_prop, aes(x = stream, y = prop, fill = taxon)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ depth) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "Stream",
    y = "Relative abundance",
    fill = "Taxon"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

```

### Visualizations

#### Average Sample Abundance
```{r}
bugs %>%
  mutate(
    sample_abundance = rowSums(
      as.data.frame(across(all_of(species_cols))),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(stream, depth) %>%
  summarise(
    total_abundance = sum(sample_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_samples = n(),
    mean_sample_abundance = total_abundance / n_samples,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stream = factor(
      stream,
      levels = c("is-11", "is-10", "is-7", "is-1", "is-5", "is-6", "is-8")
    ),
    depth = factor(depth, levels = c("surber", "25", "50"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = stream, y = mean_sample_abundance, fill = depth)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    y = "Average abundance per sample",
    x = "Stream",
    title = "Average Sample Abundance per Stream and Depth"
  ) +
  scale_fill_discrete(
    name = "Depth",
    labels = c(
      "25" = "25 cm",
      "50" = "50 cm",
      "surber" = "Surface (0 cm)"
    )
  )
```

#### Heatmap of Relative Abundances (proportions)
```{r}
# 25cm
dat25 <- bugs_long_prop %>%
  filter(depth == "25")

p25 <- ggplot(dat25, aes(x = stream, y = taxon)) +
  geom_tile(
    data = filter(dat25, prop == 0),
    fill = "lightgrey",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    data = filter(dat25, prop > 0),
    aes(fill = prop),
    color = "white"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ depth, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    limits = c(0,1),
    labels = scales::percent,
    direction = -1,
    name = "Proportion"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Stream",
    y = "Taxon",
    title = "Proportional Abundance of Taxa at 25cm"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# 50cm
dat50 <- bugs_long_prop %>%
  filter(depth == "50")

p50 <- ggplot(dat50, aes(x = stream, y = taxon)) +
  geom_tile(
    data = filter(dat50, prop == 0),
    fill = "lightgrey",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    data = filter(dat50, prop > 0),
    aes(fill = prop),
    color = "white"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ depth, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    limits = c(0,1),
    labels = scales::percent,
    direction = -1,
    name = "Proportion"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Stream",
    y = "Taxon",
    title = "Proportional Abundance of Taxa at 50cm"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Surface
datsurber <- bugs_long_prop %>%
  filter(depth == "surber")

p_surber <- ggplot(datsurber, aes(x = stream, y = taxon)) +
  geom_tile(
    data = filter(datsurber, prop == 0),
    fill = "lightgrey",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    data = filter(datsurber, prop > 0),
    aes(fill = prop),
    color = "white"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ depth, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    limits = c(0,1),
    labels = scales::percent,
    direction = -1,
    name = "Proportion"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Stream",
    y = "Taxon",
    title = "Proportional Abundance of Taxa at Surface of Benthic Layer"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

(p25 | p50) /
  (p_surber | guide_area()) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p25
p50
p_surber
```

### Heatmap of Total Abundances
```{r}
# 25 cm depth
bugs_long %>%
  filter(depth == "25") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = stream, y = taxon, fill = total_count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", name = "Count") +  #limits= c(0, 400)
  labs(
    x = "Stream",
    y = "Taxon",
    fill = "Abundance",
    title = "Total Abundance of Taxa at 25cm"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )
```
